title: Distilled's Cobblemon
description: A Cobblemon centric modpack with exploration to have fun
body:
Distilled's Cobblemon is a Cobblemon centric modpack with several adventuring aspects to make your vanilla cobblemon experience feel lively. 


Followed by multiple structure generation mods as well as terrain mods is Cobblemon with numerous addons to enhance the experience. Enjoy the modpack through adventuring or simply just building and taking it slow with the quality of life changes or furniture mods. 


Best to play with friends but certainly doable by yourself!

- **Cobblemon Ride on!** to support mounting pokemon

- **Mega Showdown** for Mega Evolution, Z moves, Terastal and Legendaries

- **CobbleCuisine** to fit the Gourmet needs 

- **CobbleLoot** provides the desire for exploration

- **Fight or Flight** for _Minecraft Realism_

- **_Radical Trainers_** for Hard/Medium Progression

- **Immersive Aircrafts** and **Small Ships** for vehicular transport

- For Structures we have the **Moog Series** 

- World Generation comes in **Better Nether and Terralith**

As well as several other mods to provide in QOL and comfort needs. 

Recommended to play on 5-6+ GB Ram
Possible to play on 4GB (Will need to turn down settings)
